verses.1: And Jehovah delivered Eibov from the storm. And He said:
verses.2: Who is this “mind” that makes decisions without any knowledge?
verses.3: Oh, may God wash away your sins and guide you. I ask you to tell me.
verses.4: Where were you at the beginning of the earth? If only you knew that in those days…
verses.5: Who put it there? Or who placed it on it?
verses.6: Why were its branches broken off? Or what caused the wood to decay?
verses.7: In the morning, the stars shone brightly, and all the gods rejoiced.
verses.8: And he spread out a sea before their gates, emerging from the depths of space.
verses.9: In my heart, there are clouds of darkness and gloom.
verses.10: And I will seal it with seals, and I will put spices on its doors.
verses.11: And he said, “Do not enter here. Do not add anything to it. And do not boast in your glory.”
verses.12: You were commanded yesterday to know the place of darkness.
verses.13: To hold onto the wings of the earth, and to drive away the wicked from it.
verses.14: It will turn into tar, and it will stand still, like a lump of tar.
verses.15: And the light of evil will be driven away from them, and their high positions will be overturned.
verses.16: You came to the shores of the sea, and while studying the land, you walked around it.
verses.17: Behold, you will see the gates of death and the gates of hell.
verses.18: You have traveled throughout the lands of the world, but if you truly knew them all…
verses.19: This is the place where light and darkness coexist. This is its location.
verses.20: For you will take us to his border, and you will understand the paths of his house.
verses.21: You know that at that time you will be born, and the number of your days will be many.
verses.22: You will bring forth snow and ice, and you will also bring forth barrenness.
verses.23: I have been in hiding during those days of sorrow and war.
verses.24: This is the path that will be illuminated by light, which will shine upon the earth.
verses.25: From where to go, up the hill; and along the path to the place where one can rest.
verses.26: To build it on the land where no man or person has ever lived before.
verses.27: To give life and to bring forth offspring, and to nurture what has been created.
verses.28: Perhaps the master was a father, or maybe he was someone who originated Eglai-Tal.
verses.29: From where did the ice come, and from where did the heavens be born?
verses.30: As water, they are submerged; and the faces of the mountains are covered with water.
verses.31: Be careful of those who are stubborn and obstinate, like a foolish fool.
verses.32: He brings forth evil things at his time, and he causes chaos among his children.
verses.33: You will know the laws of heaven if you walk on earth.
verses.34: May your steps be firm, and may the abundance of waters cover you.
verses.35: Send storms, and they will go away. Then they will say to you, “Here we are.”
verses.36: Who gave wisdom to those who were wise, or who granted understanding to those who understood?
verses.37: Who can tell stories of wisdom and the kings of heaven? Who can bring them to life?
verses.38: In the valley of Apar, the moats and trenches were filled.
verses.39: May there be a place for me to live, and may there be life like that of the birds.
verses.40: For those who are destroyed in their trials, they will sit in the judgment seat for eternity.
verses.41: Who will take care of his livestock, when his children are in need and starve?
